items.tx:
The Walk Away option:

The President can avoid another round of diplomatic frustrations and dangerous escalation by simply declaring victory and walking away. President Trump has already laid the groundwork for this scenario; each time he’s discussed the war and listed off the number of Iranian capabilities we’ve destroyed, he’s messaging a win. 

Per his own statements, the war ends when Trump says it’s over. 

Now is the perfect time for him to say it’s over. 
 
By pulling our blockade from the Gulf & our troops out of our remaining bases in the region, we end the conflict kinetically while simultaneously (finally) depriving Iran a key point of leverage: actionable military targets to strike. We essentially force Iran to reopen the SOH because they can no longer reasonably justify attacking ships without an active aggressor to blame. 

The Iranians have demonstrated that they care deeply about public opinion—therefore, once we lift the blockade, they’re likely to engage in serious talks with the Gulf states to come up with an arrangement that quickly opens the SOH. 

We then use economic leverage to our advantage: we offer incremental sanctions relief on Iranian oil to make opening SOH a non-negotiable for the Iranians. While President Trump takes a victory lap about having ended the war & ensuring that Iran won’t have a nuclear weapon, our diplomats can quietly work with our Gulf allies and the Iranians to negotiate a workable peace plan that ensures the SOH stays open. 
 
Right now Iranian leaders are unable to make many concessions with the U.S. threatening another round of strikes. 

The Iranian people rallied around the hardliners in their government after we killed the former supreme leader & members of his family including children, and the tragic bombing of a girl’s school. If you understand basic human nature, you’ll understand why all of this has had a radicalizing effect on their population. Now, many Iranians believe that the only acceptable path forward, for the sake of their national pride and to deter future attacks, is by forcing a badly blooded U.S. retreat from the region. 

Our walking away from the conflict will provide Iranian leadership a symbolic victory they can tout to their now-galvanized people, allowing more latitude for them to eventually reach a compromise with us on bigger items, like the nuclear issue. By walking away, we buy more trade space for compromise in future negotiations that won’t be possible if we remain poised to strike Iran. 
 
At the moment, Trump has the political power in the U.S. to sell walking away as a victory to his base. Of course, the same neocons who talked him into this war will complain and attack him, but they don’t represent a legitimate constituency. 

This war is widely unpopular—ending it will be widely popular. In the long run, history will commend Trump for choosing this option. 

In recognizing that the war was a mistake, and by leaving quickly before getting bogged down in a quagmire, he avoids falling into the gambler’s fallacy that ensnared many of his predecessors and got thousands of Americans killed.

As images of Capt Smit Macchar’s lacerated scalp surfaced, Dhruv Rathee again faced backlash for claiming in a now-deleted video that "people are saying this is a false flag operation."

In his defense, Rathee argued he was merely quoting others.

This is classic rhetorical framing used to introduce a conspiracy theory and inject baseless claims into public discourse while maintaining plausible deniability.

For an influencer with millions of followers, this is logically flawed and socially irresponsible. The distinction between making an assertion directly and framing it as an external rumor is negligible in terms of audience impact; the moment he amplified an unfounded "false flag" narrative, even wrapped in neutral framing, he granted it visibility and unearned credibility, planting seeds of doubt without taking accountability.

It would have been acceptable had he immediately debunked those rumors as false, baseless conspiracy theories after quoting them. But he didn't. Instead, he simply stated that people were calling it a false flag and suggested waiting for the investigation to find out, leaving an unfounded conspiracy on equal footing with facts.

Imagine a scenario where the world is battling a severe pandemic similar to COVID-19, and a creator states, "People are saying 80% of the world's population will be wiped out, but let's see if it's true or not." It would create immense panic among everyday viewers who trust him, even if he relies on plausible deniability.

A strong decision by the U.S. State Department – authorizing Ukraine’s purchase of Patriot interceptors to counter Russian ballistic missiles. Five hundred PAC-3 interceptors is a substantial number, and very soon – this winter – they COULD make for a highly effective defense package. However, it has been stipulated that deliveries may begin ONLY IN A FEW YEARS. We are asking our American partners to find a solution for the time when there is a real danger and a real need to use PAC-3 interceptors.

Right now, the Russians are attacking our energy infrastructure every single day. In just these past two weeks of October, there have already been more than 30 Russian strikes on critical parts of our power grid. It is right now, even before the beginning of winter, that Putin has started carrying out his operation to attack the systems that sustain life in our cities and communities. The targets are electricity, heating, water supplies, bridges, and life in our cities in general.

We did ask our American partners to provide Ukraine with a winter support package – at a rate of 100 Patriot interceptors per month. Five hundred missiles would be enough to protect our skies over the coming months – precisely when it is so important for Ukraine to be in a strong position in negotiations and for Russia NOT to succeed in breaking life in Ukrainian cities and communities.

The United States, our European partners, and other partners around the world have sufficient stocks of PAC-3 interceptors in their warehouses. Providing them to Ukraine right now – in the winter of 2026–2027 – and replenishing our partners’ arsenals LATER, in THE FOLLOWING YEARS, through this production already contracted and paid for by Ukraine and our partners would be the right approach. And it is entirely feasible.

We are grateful to President Trump. Importantly, we recently discussed PAC-3 interceptors with Secretary of State Marco Rubio. Ukraine is grateful to the U.S. State Department and the U.S. Administration overall for granting this authorization. But we are asking for decisions that can guarantee the protection of lives not the day after tomorrow or sometime later, but at the very moment the threat is there – when Russia is killing and destroying. I thank everyone who stands with Ukraine!

Well, duh.

There is not, and never has been, a single adequate, rational, even remotely sane reason to wage a war aimed at destroying Ukraine. This is the stupidest, most brainless, absurd, pointless, contrived, and deceitful war in human history.

The Kremlin wanted to give Donald Trump a little gift ahead of the elections, so the Kremlin gave an order to put the bloodbath on hold for a few dozen hours.

All it would take is a single order from the Kremlin, and not only would a local ceasefire become possible, but the entire war would end. Just like that. Instantly.

And 95% of Russians wouldn't give a single damn. They would happily accept absolutely anything as yet another "great victory of Russian arms," provided that's how state television explained it to them.

items.tx:
Israeli hostage survivor Bar Kupershtein, 24, has revealed the horrific torture, starvation and psychological abuse he endured during 738 days in Hamas captivity, including being forced to dig his own grave for a propaganda video, suffering repeated beatings and losing 65 pounds (29 kg).

Kupershtein described spending most of his captivity underground with five other hostages, without daylight, proper sanitation or sufficient food.

The hostages slept on thin mattresses on the floor, dug a hole beside them to use as a toilet and were allowed to shower only once a month. Their drinking water was contaminated, while meals consisted of rice and half a pita bread with cheese, infested with maggots.

Kupershtein recalled how Hamas terrorists repeatedly told the hostages that Israel had abandoned them and wanted them dead. They were also forced to record propaganda videos praising their captors.

Following the collapse of hostage negotiations in early 2025, the abuse intensified.
"Hamas came day after day and beat us," he recalled.

During one particularly brutal assault, terrorists blindfolded Kupershtein and fellow hostage Yosef Chaim Ohana, struck him in the face, dragged him by his leg into another room and tied his legs together.

He feared they were preparing to amputate one of his legs. The beating lasted approximately 30 minutes and left him unable to stand properly for a month.

Kupershtein had been working as a security guard at the Nova music festival on October 7, 2023, when Hamas launched its massacre.

Before being kidnapped, he convinced a police commander to open an emergency exit, helping more than 2,000 festivalgoers escape. He also used an all-terrain vehicle to evacuate injured people before terrorists overran the festival.

He was eventually captured and taken into Gaza.

Despite the horrific conditions, Kupershtein said he and his fellow hostages maintained their Jewish traditions, gathering every week for Kiddush prayers using salty water instead of wine.

On October 13, 2025, after 738 days in captivity, Kupershtein was released alongside 19 other surviving hostages.

His reunion with his family was especially emotional. His father, who had lost the ability to walk following a motorcycle accident in 2019, managed to stand to welcome him home.

A year later, Kupershtein says he has learned to appreciate the simplest freedoms, including opening his refrigerator, eating whenever he wants and taking a shower.

He has since traveled internationally to share his testimony, met US President Donald Trump at the White House and published his memoir, Unbreakable.

We've been together for a few years now and she's really putting the pressure on about wanting to get married and start a family, but my folks got divorced when I was a kid and marriage just seems so scary to me. But I love her so much and I don't want to lose her. Are you married sir?" and the older man says "I am, in fact my wife and I recently celebrated our 50th anniversary." 

So the younger man says "that's amazing, I'd love that to be us. Do you mind me asking how did you know she was THE ONE?"

The older man tells him "its actually a funny story, when I was your age I was a bit of a playboy, always going out with different women every night and it was pretty routine for me to have 2 or 3 steady girlfriends at a time. But a lot of my friends were settling down and starting families and I started thinking about how I wanted that for myself. The problem was I was seeing 3 different women at the time, and every one of them was someone I could really see building a life and a future with. All 3 were smart and funny and beautiful and I always had a great time with each of them. So I decided I'd give each one $100, that was a lot of money back then!, and tell them to do whatever they wanted with it and I figured I'd get a good idea of what kind of wife and mother they would be by how they spent it. 

So I gave the first girl I had been seeing the money and told her to do whatever she wanted and she said "well I tell you what I'm going to do with it, I'm going to go to the beauty parlor and get all done up, buy a new dress, and take you out on the town tonight. We'll go to your favorite restaurant and then out to a nightclub and you can make all the other fellas jealous!" And she really did look like a movie star, I was so proud to be seen with her on my arm and I thought what a fun time we would have as a couple. 

Well then the next day I see the second woman I'd been seeing and tell her the same thing, and she thinks for a minute and says "well, I'd hate to spend all that money on myself. If its ok I'd like to give it to my brother, you know he and his family have really been going through some hard times. He was in that awful car wreck and had to be in the hospital for weeks. They've got a lot of bills piled up from that and this would really help him and his wife out so much, is it ok if I give to them?" and I thought what a kind and generous person she was, if she was that thoughtful to her brother and his family how much more would she be with ours.

Well then I see the third woman, and I give her the money and tell her the same thing. She thinks for a bit and says "I'm going to take this down to the bank and buy a savings bond with it. I don't really need anything right now but you never know what the future holds and it would be a good idea for us to start thinking about the future, this would be a good way to start." And I thought what a smart and practical woman, she'd make such a fantastic wife and mother, someone I know I could trust to make good decisions for our family."

The young man looks at him and says "wow, all that must have made it an even tougher decision. How did you decide?"

And the older man says "I picked the one with the biggest boobs."

items.tx:
Let's fact-check this IDBI lie 

Lie 1: "IDBI made profitable by public funding, why sell?"

Truth: IDBI was made NPA by UPA. In Sept 2018, Gross NPA was 31.78% - BANK WAS DEAD. Modi Govt + LIC put Rs 24,000cr in 2019 to SAVE it, not to run it forever. Now NPA is 2.32% and profit Rs 9,513cr. So govt rescued with public money, revived, and now encashing Rs 52,878cr. This is EXACTLY what you do - buy sick PSU, cure it, sell at profit. What should govt do? Run banks forever?

Lie 2: "Why controlling stake? Why not minority/tranches?"
Because no one buys minority in a bank you can't control. IDBI is already classified as PRIVATE BANK since 2019 (after LIC took 51%). Govt decided in 2021 to exit fully. Strategic buyer needs 51%+ to get RBI license, to bring management, capital. Selling 5% via OFS every year is Congress style disinvestment - and IDBI share was Rs 40 in 2020. You would have sold at scrap then.

And FYI - Govt is NOT selling 100%. After this sale, Govt still holds 15% + LIC 19% = 34% retained. Govt will sell that 15% later in market at higher price. So tranches happening only.

Lie 3: "Sold below reserve price at Rs 81 vs Rs 94.42 - Railway scrap rule"

Biggest lie. Official PIB press note (Oct 14):
- Round 1 in FY26: Reserve was Rs 94.42 - ALL bids were below, GOVT REJECTED. No sale. That's 56 inch, not folding.
- Round 2 in FY27: Fresh valuation by 2 INDEPENDENT agencies after March 2026 results. Average fair value = Rs 75.99 per share. Fairfax bid Rs 81 = Rs 5 ABOVE fair value, Rs 3917cr EXTRA value created. Cabinet approved.

- Railway Stores Code? RFP clause you quote - Clause says "if bid below reserve, GoI will decide further course". GoI decided to go for fresh best-offer round. That's exactly what happened. No scrap rule used. Finance Ministry clarified yesterday Oct 30 - reserve price was neither decreased nor increased, first round became functus officio.

Lie 4: "Fairfax threatened to walk away, govt folded"

Where is letter? Source? Fairfax is Prem Watsa - Indian-origin, Canada's biggest investor. His bid cleared RBI "fit and proper" + MHA security clearance + CCEA + Inter-Ministerial Group + Core Group of Secretaries. 
Double-blind process. If govt folded, why did it reject first round bids?

Real question: If IDBI profit Rs 9500cr is "huge", why did UPA leave it with Rs 31% NPA and Rs 12,000cr loss? Who made it sick?

Rahul Gandhi says "Bombay House under threat" - Same Rahul who said HAL, BSNL, LIC will be sold? LIC IPO is now Rs 6 lakh cr market cap. HAL share Rs 4,800 from Rs 800.
Stop reading Business World WhatsApp forwards. 
Read PIB.

items.tx:
#News Democrat Mary Peltola’s campaign operatives directed a months-long secret operation to recruit another Dan Sullivan onto Alaska’s Senate ballot to confuse voters and peel support from the Republican incumbent.

Last summer, a staffer for Democratic Senate candidate Peltola was told to search Alaska voter records and put together a list of every person named Dan Sullivan in the state.

The goal was to find and recruit a Dan Sullivan who could appear on the state’s ranked-choice ballot and peel votes from incumbent Republican Sen. Dan S. Sullivan, according to a new report released by the New York Times.

The operation was called Ballot Composition Project.”

It involved Peltola’s lawyers, senior DSCC aides, and an Ohio-based operative named Jerid Kurtz, who was a specialist in secret ballot maneuvers.

Kurtz traveled to Alaska under the fake name “Zane,” using cover stories and meeting potential candidates over beers at bars.

Text messages show campaign and DSCC officials coordinating for months, with aides referring to Kurtz as “Jarid,” “Jared,” or “our friend.”

#vote
The plan worked. Earlier this year a retired teacher from a small fishing village reachable only by air and sea announced his Senate candidacy.

His name was Dan J. Sullivan. He said he “hated Trump and wanted to help Mary.”
Kurtz said he “didn’t have any interest in being a politician, but if this could help,” he’d do it.

Dan J. Sullivan filed in late May, ran as a Republican, finished third in the Aug. 18 primary with 2.5% of the vote, and advanced to the general election ballot listed as “Daniel J. Sullivan Jr.” with no party affiliation.

The campaign also talked about creating a new right-wing party to take votes from Sullivan, then asked a progressive to drop out so the field would be the two Sullivans, another Republican Gerald Heikes - who was also recruited - and Peltola, the only Democrat.

Elisa Rios, Peltola’s former campaign manager and longtime aide, told the Times that Peltola “was not directly involved in the project” but was “definitely aware.”

Anton McParland, then Peltola’s chief of staff, helped with the coordination.

A pro-Peltola super PAC paid $87,000 to a firm co-owned by Kurtz this fall; the PAC denied hiring him for any services.

Republicans tried and failed in state court to remove Dan J. Sullivan, with the Alaska Supreme Court ruling in June that no statute authorized exclusion for lacking “good faith.”

President Donald Trump said Democrats

“Illegally searched for, and recruited, a man named Dan Sullivan” to “defraud, confuse, and obfuscate the Election.”

He called it “ELECTION FRAUD,” said Democrats “perjured themselves” in court denials, and argued Peltola and “FAKE Dan Sullivan” should be removed from the ballot so the real senator can run alone.

The Justice Department sued last week to block certification if votes for the other Sullivan tip the race against the incumbent.

What do you think? Should recruiting people with the same name, convincing others to drop out, and planning to create another party, all to help a candidate win, be illegal?

#ChristinaAguayoNews

BREAKING: Democrat operatives spent months hunting Alaskans named “Dan Sullivan” to confuse voters and help Mary Peltola beat Sen. Dan Sullivan.

A Peltola staffer was tasked with finding every voter by that name and coaxing them to run. It worked: a retired teacher from a tiny fishing village (reachable only by air or sea) is now on the ballot as Dan J. Sullivan. No campaign events. Almost no interviews. 

Has voted Democrat before.

Internally called the “ballot composition project.” Secret trips to remote towns. A mysterious Midwestern operative using a fake name, pitching candidates over beers.

Peltola’s former campaign manager says she was “definitely aware.” Documents show the effort was broader—they also recruited another Republican (Gerald Heikes) to siphon votes.

Alaska is one of the closest Senate races. Two Dan Sullivans + a spoiler = deliberate voter confusion.

They do this, then lecture you about “defending democracy.”
